name: Muesli
siboNotes: Contains multiple FODMAP types from dried fruits, nuts, and oats. Start with very small portions and monitor symptoms carefully.
preparationTips: Check ingredient list carefully - avoid varieties with dried apples, pears, or dates
Look for simple oat-based muesli with minimal dried fruit
Serve with lactose-free milk or small portions of almond milk
Consider making homemade version with low-FODMAP ingredients
nutritionalHighlights: High in fiber and complex carbohydrates
Good source of protein from nuts and seeds
